fixtures.name: adv16
fixtures.weights: deterministic dense QR rotation / diagonal gain / QR rotation

compression: deterministic top-4 SVD of mode-3 unfolding after each nonlinear birth; reshape left modes to symmetric R; full tensor symmetrization
reference: synthetic ARC K=3 SIMPLE factorized state only; no benchmark targets/reference means/datasets

cost_policy.rule: A complete production birth/recompression algorithm with a finite all-in upper bound is mandatory. The small-fixture dense SVD is forbidden in production. If no n^3-free production recompression is demonstrated within 14.04 units, the cost gate fails.

failure_policy: Any failed or unevaluable gate => terminal NO-GO. No rerun, rank sweep, rescue, seed replacement, public/scorer/holdout/full run, target access, canonical or ledger mutation.
